PRODUCT INFORMATION
 PRODUCT INFORMATION 
✅ This FTIR Frontier Perkin Elmer with UATR has been fully tested at our in-house testing laboratory.
The FTIR Perkin Elmer Frontier with UATR is a versatile analytical instrument designed for comprehensive infrared analysis across mid-IR and near-IR regions. It provides high-quality spectral data for the identification and characterization of organic, inorganic, and polymeric materials. The integrated UATR (Universal Attenuated Total Reflectance) accessory enables rapid, minimal-preparation analysis of solids, liquids, and powders, improving workflow efficiency and reproducibility. With advanced optics, broad spectral range capability, and intuitive software for data acquisition and analysis, the system is widely used in pharmaceutical, chemical, environmental, and materials science laboratories for applications such as raw material identification, quality control, failure analysis, and research.
At AMPTIUS | AMP Tech Instruments, we supply high-quality analytical systems engineered to meet the demands of modern laboratories. This PerkinElmer Frontier FTIR UATR has been fully tested and includes warranty coverage for added peace of mind. Our application scientists are ready to provide professional technical guidance to help you integrate the system efficiently and maintain reliable analytical performance.

Insights by AMPTIUS | AMP Tech Instruments
High-Performance Molecular Identification Across Analytical Laboratories
If your laboratory is struggling with tedious sample preparation or weak signal-to-noise ratios during materials characterization, the PerkinElmer Frontier FTIR Spectrometer delivers the high-performance optical capabilities needed for demanding analytical workflows. Featuring a high-throughput optical bench equipped with a sensitive DLATGS detector, this versatile system spans a broad spectral range from the near-infrared through the mid-infrared, covering approximately 8,300–350 cm⁻¹, with high-resolution performance down to 0.4 cm⁻¹. By integrating a heavy-duty diamond UATR sampling accessory, the platform allows laboratories to analyze solids, powders, liquids, and polymers directly on the crystal surface without time-consuming pellet preparation or extensive grinding. Its combined FTIR/NIR capabilities support rapid material identification, raw material verification, polymer characterization, and other applications where broad spectral information is valuable. The system is well suited for industrial polymer characterization, environmental analysis, and pharmaceutical laboratories requiring rapid, non-destructive raw material verification, contaminant identification, or counterfeit product screening.
Perkin Elmer Frontier FTIR Price and Cost of Ownership: Reliable Performance at Lower Cost
The PerkinElmer Frontier FT-IR/NIR Spectrometer with a Universal Attenuated Total Reflectance (UATR) accessory provides a versatile and cost-effective solution for pharmaceutical, polymer, chemical, environmental, forensic, and materials science laboratories requiring advanced infrared spectroscopy capabilities. New systems typically range from approximately $80,000 to $100,000, depending on optical configuration, detector options, and software packages, while certified pre-owned systems generally range from $30,000 to $45,000, offering substantial savings on initial capital investment. In addition to acquisition costs, laboratories should consider ongoing operational expenses such as preventive maintenance, desiccant replacement, detector servicing, ATR crystal maintenance, wavelength validation, software support, and compliance-related qualification activities for USP, ASTM, ISO, GMP, and quality control workflows. Long-term ownership costs are generally lower than many chromatographic and mass spectrometric platforms because FT-IR systems require minimal consumables and have relatively simple routine maintenance requirements. Purchasing a certified pre-owned PerkinElmer Frontier FT-IR/NIR Spectrometer with UATR allows laboratories to significantly reduce ownership costs while still benefiting from broad spectral range coverage, rapid non-destructive analysis, excellent spectral resolution, and proven performance for material identification, raw material verification, polymer characterization, and advanced spectroscopic research applications.
Perkin Elmer FTIR Spectrometer Frontier with UATR: Raw Material Identification & Verification (ID Testing)
The PerkinElmer Frontier FT-IR/NIR Spectrometer with a Universal Attenuated Total Reflectance (UATR) accessory provides an excellent platform for raw material identification and verification (ID testing) in pharmaceutical, chemical, polymer, food, and manufacturing laboratories. The system generates highly reproducible infrared spectral fingerprints that enable rapid confirmation of incoming raw materials, active ingredients, excipients, polymers, and specialty chemicals against established reference libraries and validated specifications. The UATR accessory allows direct analysis of powders, solids, liquids, gels, films, and finished materials with little to no sample preparation, significantly reducing analysis time while improving laboratory productivity. The Frontier's combined FT-IR and NIR capabilities expand material characterization options, with NIR providing additional opportunities for rapid, non-destructive screening applications such as moisture content analysis and compositional assessment. Laboratories benefit from fast, non-destructive testing, simplified workflow execution, and reliable spectral matching that supports quality control programs and regulatory compliance initiatives, including applications aligned with USP <197> and other identity testing requirements. Combined with excellent spectral resolution, robust software tools, and proven analytical reliability, the PerkinElmer Frontier FT-IR/NIR Spectrometer with UATR provides a dependable solution for efficient and accurate raw material verification and complementary NIR screening workflows.
AMP Tech Analytical Solutions for Academic Research and Grant-Funded Laboratories
At AMPTIUS | AMP Tech Instruments, we support the advancement of scientific education and innovation by providing cost-effective analytical instruments tailored to the unique budget constraints of the academic sector. Every pre-owned system in our inventory is independently evaluated and fully verified within our in-house testing laboratory, making our AMP Tech Certified equipment an ideal choice for university chemistry departments, core facilities, and researchers optimizing limited grant funding. Because academic applications vary heavily from undergraduate teaching labs to complex graduate research, we precisely document each unique listing to ensure the specific components align with your educational goals or specific institutional SOPs. To guarantee that your system includes the exact module configuration required for your research methodology and to align with your university’s procurement process or funding timeline, we highly encourage you to connect directly with our active sales management team or request a customized quote before purchase.
